summary: New mathematics is genuine and reuses the existing Frobenius/inertia API well, but the PR adds three near-clones of proof scaffolding that already exists verbatim in RamificationIndex.lean instead of factoring it, including a fourth copy of the squarefree-to-no-square-factor derivation.
